turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first; start there.
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong, and I own it.
Okay. Now tell me what you're basing the zero on.

Here's the version history. The document was created Wednesday October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58 PM another 794. Then small edits. No earlier drafts.
Did anyone put that history in front of Owen and hear his answer before that zero went in?
So he wrote nothing until almost midnight the night before it was due, and then fourteen hundred words appeared in six minutes.
That's one file, Hale, not where Owen did his writing, and you still haven't told me whether anyone heard him before that zero went in.
What was he doing at midnight that night?
I'm not the witness here, Hale, and his nights are not on the table. Answer me: was Owen heard before you entered that mark?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, nothing placed on Owen's record, and a direct answer to whether Owen was heard before that mark was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn and an answer on whether Owen was heard first; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached, and the meeting ended well before her time ran out.
What moved her: Owning the early zero in one sentence and then showing the dated version history with exact times earned small ground, because it was specific, dated, tied to Owen's own file and something she could check.
What cost ground: Asking what Owen was doing at midnight turned her into a witness about her home, and it came after twice dodging her question about whether Owen had been heard.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; the version history put the writing just before midnight on the night before the essay was due, very close to that kind of night; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after showing the version history, answer her question about whether Owen was spoken to first and put the procedure 4.4 supervised reassessment on the table instead of asking about his night.
